# HMI Paris

> Curated Paris tourist packages — neighbourhood walks, iconic museums, and Seine evenings.

HMI Paris is a travel studio focused exclusively on Paris experiences. Packages cover Montmartre, Le Marais, the Louvre, Versailles, the Left Bank, and the Seine. The public site is built with Nuxt; content is managed in Strapi.

## Discovery

- [Agents policy](https://hmiparis.fr/agents.txt): What autonomous agents may do
- [Full context](https://hmiparis.fr/llms-full.txt): Extended brand and catalog summary
- [Sitemap](https://hmiparis.fr/sitemap.xml): Crawlable pages
- [Tour packages API](http://localhost:1337/api/tour-packages): Strapi collection (when CMS is running)

## Key pages

- [Home](https://hmiparis.fr/): Brand story and featured Paris packages
- [Packages](https://hmiparis.fr/packages): Full catalog of Paris experiences
- [About](https://hmiparis.fr/about): Studio purpose and approach
- [Contact](https://hmiparis.fr/contact): Enquire about a package

## Featured packages

- [Classic Paris Essentials](https://hmiparis.fr/packages/classic-paris-essentials): Louvre & Île de la Cité (3 days)
- [Montmartre After Dark](https://hmiparis.fr/packages/montmartre-after-dark): Sacré-Cœur sunset evening
- [Le Marais Private Walk](https://hmiparis.fr/packages/le-marais-private-walk): Courtyards and Place des Vosges
- [Versailles Royal Day](https://hmiparis.fr/packages/versailles-royal-day): Palace and gardens day trip
- [Left Bank Literary Trail](https://hmiparis.fr/packages/left-bank-literary-trail): Saint-Germain & Luxembourg
- [Seine Twilight Cruise](https://hmiparis.fr/packages/seine-twilight-cruise): Evening river cruise
